content: {"reasoning":"The prior CO-197 denial reflects missing required authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. An appeal has already been filed, but no current payer response supports another appeal or an information submission; resubmission would not cure the authorization defect. Escalate for appeal-status follow-up because no available automated action can properly advance the pending appeal, and neither transferring the authorization denial to the patient nor writing off the balance is justified.","action":"escalate"}
